prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name a single “best” company — the best fit depends on your budget, the size/age of the job, and the level of finish you want. I can, however, help you find a top interior painter in St. Louis and tell you how to pick one. Quick guidance:

What to consider when choosing a painter
- Licensing, insurance and workers’ comp (must be current).
- Local reviews and references — check Google, Yelp, Angi/Houzz and the BBB; ask for recent job references you can contact.
- Experience with interiors like yours (older homes with lead paint, historic trim, high ceilings).
- Preparation and cleanup practices (taping, priming, patching, furniture protection).
- Paint brands and warranties (Benjamin Moore, Sherwin‑Williams; ask about a finish/warranty).
- Written estimate that breaks out labor, materials, primer, number of coats, and timeline.
- Whether the crew are employees or subcontractors.
- A sample/patch or color consultation option.

Questions to ask any painter before hiring
- Are you licensed/insured? Can you show proof?
- Do you have references from similar jobs?
- What’s included in the estimate (prep, patching, caulk, primer, number of coats)?
- Who will do the work (employees or subs)? Who supervises?
- What brand/type of paint will you use? Is paint included in the price?
- What is the projected start date and completion time? What’s your warranty?

If you’d like, I can:
- Look up the current top-rated interior painters in St. Louis and give a short list with contact info and average ratings.
- Or recommend 3–5 companies tailored to your job (tell me: single room or whole house? year built? budget range? desired start date?)

Which would you prefer?
